arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_value_transactions FROM transactions WHERE amount_usd_cents > 500000
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions with an amount of more than $5,000.
assumptions: 'More than $5,000' is taken as strictly greater than 500000 cents.
All transactions across the full data range (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31) are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label.
